headline: What an honor named Justin Bieber the White Boy of the Year during the Believe That Awards
body: What an honor named Justin Bieber the White Boy of the Year during the Believe That Awards (it went to Timothée Chalamet last year). He beat out fellow nominees Tom Holland, Erling Haaland, Robert Pattinson and Travis Kelce, and actually recorded a video reacting to the award. :.
